observations.trace: Original059 Adler finding ADLER-L11-VISTA-PLAYABLE-SEAM-FRAME already records that vista_triangle_height converts a world point to LOD-local coordinates, then clips against an unshifted playable-centred half extent. PlacementGround::height_at calls that same helper after an absent terrain height. A source-only illustration retains the original assumptions: a flat scene terrain centred at0 with half extents1, a valid3×3 vista at spacing2 with origin (10,0), and a point at world (10,0). The point is outside the actual playable square but local (0,0). The local vista cell [0,2]×[0,2] is clipped into [1,2]×[0,2] and [0,1]×[1,2]; neither contains the point, so this helper returns None. A candidate requiring that support point is rejected by the selected accept path if it otherwise reaches the height check. No terrain, ring, furniture or test was run.
